annotations.title: vvhen ſhal theſe things be.
annotations.text: The miſeries which did fall before the deſtruction of the Temple and citie of Hieruſalem, were a reſemblance of the extreme calamitie that ſhal befall before the later day at the time of Antichriſt: wherevpon Chriſt ſpeaketh indifferently of both.

annotations.title: I am he.
annotations.text: ◦ As before the deſtruction of Hieruſalem, diuerſe Seducers aroſe, and called them ſelues Chriſtes, promiſing the people deliuerance from the feares and dangers they were in of forraine ſouldiars: ſo ſhal there come many towards the end of the world, and make them ſelues Chriſtes and Authors of Sectes, and ſhal gaine many Diſciples: as in plaine wordes foloweth in this chapter v. 22. There ſhal riſe vp Falſe-Chriſts and Falſe-Prophets &c.

annotations.title: The abomination of deſolation.
annotations.text: No hereſie doth ſo properly and purpoſely tend to this abomination of deſolation <mn>[1]</mn> which by Antichriſt ſhal be atchieued, as this <mn>[2]</mn> Caluiniſme: which taketh away with other Sacraments and external worſhip of God, the very ſacrifice of Chriſtes Body and bloud. Which being taken away (as S. Cyprian ſaith) no religion can remaine.

notes.text: Hyppolyt. li. de Antichristo. Cypr. de Coen. Do. nu. 2.
Caluinisme tendeth to the abomination of desolation.

annotations.title: Signes and Wonders.
annotations.text: Falſe-Chriſtes and Falſe-Prophets be ſeducers, who in the later day by the power of the diuel ſhal ſeeme to worke wonders, and yet men muſt not beleeue them. Much leſſe theſe, which for their falſe faith can not ſhew ſo much as one falſe miracle.
